caption: The drawing depicts two square quilt blocks, each divided into four triangular sections arranged in a pinwheel pattern. The upper quilt block features four different fabric patterns: one with a brown background and green circles, one with a grid design in light brown and pink colors, one with a narrow pink and green floral stripe, and another with a solid area in muted purple. The colors in this block are predominantly browns, pinks, and subtle greens. The lower quilt block also uses four triangular sections in a pinwheel layout, alternating blue fabric with irregular light spots and pink fabric with small red floral motifs. The background of the drawing is plain off-white. The two quilt blocks are separated by some handwritten text that reads "Carl Bourgerius."
title: Squares of Patchwork
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
